theme: hotel clerk who could seat everyone, if only she noticed
title: The Clerk Who Redacted Her Own Calendar
strategies: weak roster-order first-fit: seat guests exactly in the (already scrambled) id order into the first compatible room, never reordering (reproduces the evaluator's weak reference)

value-descending first-fit: prioritise the highest-value guest each step, seat into the first compatible room -- beats roster order but reasons about value alone, so one long-staying high-value guest can block many smaller collectively-more-valuable guests for good
Maximum-Cardinality-Search chordality detection + maximum-weight clique-tree spanning forest: recover a linear (interval) calendar order for each roster component from the clash graph alone

min-cost-flow spill placement on the reconstructed calendar axis: R room-tracks threaded through time via successive shortest augmenting paths pick exactly the value-maximising subset of guests to seat, then a sweep in reconstructed order assigns real rooms (falling back to turning a guest away on the spot if the reconstruction was imperfect)
